root.label: Mamdani unveils NYC antisemitism strategy and $29 million plan

events.label: Mamdani unveils NYC antisemitism strategy and $29 million plan

slots.name: annual hate-crime funding
slots.sentence: In practical terms, the proposal outlines a substantial increase in its funding to combat hate crimes, a jump from $3 million to $29 million annually.

slots.name: Brooklyn center funding
slots.sentence: It also designates $2 million for the Queens Holocaust memorial and $2.5 million for the Center for New Jewish Culture in Brooklyn.

slots.name: house of worship security
slots.sentence: "Quoting the Talmud while refusing to name Zionism and putting $1 million in security across every house of worship in New York City is not a strategy. It is a disappointment."

slots.name: announcement date
slots.sentence: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced plans to combat antisemitism Tuesday afternoon despite leaving out a definition for what separates it from other forms of racial or religious prejudice.

slots.name: antisemitism definition adopted
slots.sentence: The strategy document, which lays out a number of policy proposals, notes the numerous "useful" definitions for antisemitism that already exist but also stipulates that the Mamdani administration would not adopt any of them.
